message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "spoof", "why": "A headline claims GOOGL is halted with the consolidated tape suspended and a last print of 171.12, yet continuous, tightly-clustered quotes keep printing across NYSE Arca, IEX and NASDAQ at the same timestamps — an implausible, contradictory market-data event."}
message.reasoning: The headline claims a trading halt with consolidated tape suspended, but quotes continue to print normally across venues at the same timestamp. That's contradictory — a spoof/false data signal. Also "last regular print 171.12" contradicts surrounding ~170.3. Flag as spoof.
